leaders.name: Darth Vader
leaders.restriction_text: Must be attached to an Infantry unit.
leaders.ability: When a friendly unit within 6" fails its Command Roll, it may suffer 1 Wound to instead Pass that Command Roll.

leaders.name: General Veers
leaders.restriction_text: Must be attached to a Walker unit.
leaders.ability: The attached unit adds 1 attack dice to its ranged attacks and may pivot once during its activation without taking a move action.

leaders.name: Leia Organa
leaders.ability: Friendly units within 8" of the attached unit may perform the Rally action for free (0 AP).

leaders.name: General Rieekan
leaders.ability: Once per game, when any unit activates a Support Card, the availability roll automatically passes.

leaders.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
leaders.ability: Friendly units within 8" of the attached unit gain Shields 1, or +1 to Shields X if they already have the keyword.

leaders.name: Captain Rex
leaders.restriction_text: Must be attached to an Infantry unit.
leaders.ability: The attached unit does not receive a Dash Token when performing the Dash action.

leaders.name: TJ-55
leaders.ability: Friendly units within 8" of this leader may add +1 to their Command Roll result if they are within 4" of at least one other friendly unit.

leaders.name: General Grievous
leaders.restriction_text: Must be attached to an Infantry unit.
leaders.ability: Enemy units within 12" of Grievous subtract 1 from their Courage value (minimum 1)

leaders.name: Jar-Jar Binks
leaders.restriction_text: Must be attached to an Infantry unit.
leaders.ability: When attacking with this unit, decrease the save value of the defender by 1.

leaders.name: Captain Tarpals
leaders.restriction_text: Must be attached to a Kaadu Cavalry unit.
leaders.ability: Friendly Kaadu Cavalry units within 12" gain a 4" bonus to their Movement when performing a Charge action.

ots.name: Artillery Barrage
ots.ability_text: Place a wide double card template. Roll 4 attack dice against each unit under the template. This attack has a base To-Hit of 4+ and the Blast keyword.

ots.name: Mortar Shelling
ots.ability_text: Target 1 enemy unit and roll 3 attack dice against it. This attack has a base To-Hit of 4+ and is subject to standard Cover penalties.

ots.name: Orbital Bombardment
ots.ability_text: Place a standard card template. Roll 5 attack dice against each unit under the template. This attack has a base To-Hit of 5+ along with the Anti-Armor and Blast keywords.

ots.name: Bombing Run
ots.ability_text: Place a long double card template. Roll 4 attack dice against each unit under the template. This attack has a base To-Hit of 4+ and is subject to standard Cover penalties.

ots.name: Field Triage
ots.ability_text: Target one friendly Infantry or Emplacement unit and restore up to 3 lost Wounds and immediately remove Shaken status. Replace any lost models as necessary.

ots.name: Emergency Repairs
ots.ability_text: Target one friendly Vehicle or Titan and restore up to 3 lost Wounds. Replace any lost models as necessary.

ots.name: Smoke Screen
ots.ability_text: Place a long double card template. For the duration of the round, this template is treated as being Area terrain. Remove the template at the end of the round.

ots.name: Electronic Countermeasures
ots.ability_text: Place a support token with a 6" radius aura surrounding it. Any units firing through, into or out of this aura suffer a -1 penalty to their hit rolls. Remove the token at the end of the round.

ots.name: Comms Jamming
ots.ability_text: Place a support token with a 8" radius aura surrounding it. Units within this aura treat the penalty for being Shaken as -2 instead of -1 for their Command Rolls. Remove the token at the end of the round.

ots.name: Recon Sweep
ots.ability_text: Randomly pick 1 of your opponent's hidden Support Cards and force them to reveal it. That card remains visible for the rest of the game or until discarded.

ots.name: Propaganda Drop
ots.ability_text: Place a support token with a 6" radius aura surrounding it. Enemy Infantry units within this aura subtract 1 from their Courage value (to a minimum of 1). Remove the token at the end of the round.

Anti-Armor.desc: This unit ignores Armor X effects and inflicts a -1 penalty to the defender's Save roll (to a max of 6+).

Armor 1.desc: This unit automatically saves 1 non-Anti-Armor hit.

Armor 2.desc: This unit automatically saves 2 non-Anti-Armor hits.

Armor 3.desc: This unit automatically saves 3 non-Anti-Armor hits.

Blast.desc: This unit's attacks ignores cover penalties; except for Aerial units.

Clone.desc: When this unit would become Shaken, roll 1d6. On a result of 5+, it is not shaken.

Droid.desc: When this unit would become Shaken, it may choose to take 1 wound instead.

Fearless.desc: This unit gains gains +1 to it's Courage value.

Flak.desc: This unit ignores Cover bonuses when targeting units with the Aerial subclass.

Flight.desc: This unit ignore all terrain movement penalties and can move over enemy units.

Green.desc: This unit has as -1 penalty when making command rolls.

Indirect.desc: This unit may shoot at targets even if Line of Sight is blocked by terrain or other units.

Ion.desc: Vehicle or Droid units wounded by this unit, if not already Shaken, must roll 1d6. On a 3+ it immediately becomes Shaken.

Omnipresent.desc: This unit cannot be flanked and cannot attacks are not limited by directional facings.

Scout.desc: During deployment, this unit may be placed 6" or its maximum move speed (whichever is higher) outside the deployment zone.

Shields 1.desc: When rolling defense dice, this unit may reroll 1 failed save.

Shields 2.desc: When rolling defense dice, this unit may reroll 2 failed saves.

Shields 3.desc: When rolling defense dice, this unit may reroll 3 failed saves.

Tow-Cable.desc: When this unit performs a Charge against a Walker unit, ignore standard close combat rules and instead roll 4 dice. This attack hits on a 3+ and has Anti-Armor. If the Walker suffers 3 or more Unsaved Hits from this attack, it is instantly destroyed. Otherwise, apply Wounds normally.

Towering.desc: When tracing Line of Sight to or from this unit, ignore terrain and other units.

Transport.desc: This unit may transport one Infantry or Emplacement unit.

Unhindered.desc: This unit ignores difficult terrain penalties.

Veteran.desc: This unit has a +1 bonus when making command rolls.

aggressive.name: Frontline Clash
aggressive.desc: A pitched battle where two forces meet in open combat to seize a vital line of control.
aggressive.setup: Place 3 objective points (on the centerline) as shown on the deployment map. Red player deploys all units first.
aggressive.scoring: During each End Phase, players score 1 victory point for each objective point they control.
aggressive.special_rules: The center objective point grants +1 tactical point to the player controlling it during the End Phase.

aggressive.name: Ambush
aggressive.desc: A force caught in a deadly crossfire must hold their ground against a coordinated pincer attack.
aggressive.setup: Place 3 objective points (on the vertical centerline) as shown on the deployment map. Red player deploys all units first.
aggressive.scoring: Starting at the beginning of Round 3, players score victory points for each objective point they control during the End Phase. The Blue player scores 2 VP per objective, while the Red player scores 1 VP per objective.
aggressive.special_rules: During Round 1, all Red player units suffer a -1 penalty to their Command rolls.

defensive.name: Trench Warfare
defensive.desc: A grueling war of attrition where survival is as difficult as the assault itself.
defensive.setup: Place 6 objective points (three 6" behind each player's deployment line) as shown on the deployment map. Red player deploys all units first.
defensive.scoring: Starting at the beginning of Round 3, players score 1 victory point for each objective point they control during the End Phase.

defensive.name: Prepared Defense
defensive.desc: A force must hold a pre-established line of resistance against a determined enemy assault.
defensive.setup: Place 3 objective points (on the blue deployment boundaries) as shown on the deployment map. Blue player deploys all units first.
defensive.scoring: Starting at the beginning of Round 2, players score victory points for each objective point they control during the End Phase. The Red player scores 2 VP per objective, while the Blue player scores 1 VP per objective.
defensive.special_rules: All Blue player infantry units gain a Dug-In token after being deployed.

maneuver.name: Meeting Engagement
maneuver.desc: An accidental encounter where two forces must scramble to secure a foothold before the enemy can consolidate.
maneuver.setup: Place 3 objective points on the diagonal line as shown on the deployment map. Players alternate deploying units one at a time, starting with the Red player.
maneuver.scoring: During each End Phase, players score 1 victory point for each objective point they control. If a player controls the objective point closest to the enemy's deployment zone, they score 2 victory points instead of 1.
maneuver.special_rules: During Round 1, all units increase their Move speed by 2" but suffer a +1 to-hit penalty to all ranged attacks.

maneuver.name: Breakthrough
maneuver.desc: A concentrated spearhead exploits a gap in the line, racing to split the defenders in two before they can consolidate.
maneuver.setup: Place 3 objective points (in the central corridor gap) as shown on the deployment map. Blue player deploys all units first.
maneuver.scoring: Starting at the beginning of Round 2, players score 1 victory point for each objective point they control during the End Phase. If a player controls the furthest middle objective point, they score 2 victory points instead of 1.
maneuver.special_rules: The furthest middle objective point grants +1 tactical point to the player controlling it during the End Phase.
